business_summary: Security National Financial Corporation engages in the life insurance, cemetery and mortuary, and mortgage businesses. The company's Life Insurance segment is involved in selling and servicing lines of life insurance, annuity products, and accident and health insurance. It offers various life insurance products, including funeral plans and interest-sensitive life insurance, as well as other traditional life, accident, and health insurance products; and annuity products comprising single and flexible premium deferred annuities, and immediate annuities. This segment also cedes and assumes various risks with various authorized unaffiliated reinsurers pursuant to reinsurance treaties. Its cemetery and mortuary segment consists of eleven mortuaries and five cemeteries in the state of Utah, one cemetery in the state of California, and one cemetery and four mortuaries in the state of New Mexico. This segment also offers plots, interment vaults, mausoleum crypts, markers, caskets, urns, and other death care related products; and provides professional services of funeral directors, opening and closing of graves, use of chapels and viewing rooms, and use of automobiles and clothing, as well as engages in pre-need selling of funeral, cemetery, mortuary, and cremation services. The company's Mortgages segment originates and underwrites residential and commercial loans for new construction, existing homes, and real estate projects primarily in Florida, Arizona, Nevada, Texas, and Utah. It offers residential mortgage lending services to real estate brokers and builders, as well as directly to consumers. Security National Financial Corporation was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah.
business_summary_ko: Security National Financial Corporation은 생명 보험, 묘지 및 영안실, 모기지 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 회사의 생명 보험 부문은 생명 보험, 연금 상품, 상해 및 건강 보험 제품군을 판매하고 서비스합니다. 장례보험, 이자민감형 생명보험은 물론 기타 전통적인 생명보험, 상해보험, 건강보험 등 다양한 생명보험 상품을 제공합니다. 단일하고 유연한 프리미엄 이연 연금과 즉시 연금으로 구성된 연금 상품입니다. 이 부문은 또한 재보험 조약에 따라 다양한 승인된 비계열 재보험사와 다양한 위험을 양도하고 부담합니다. 묘지와 영안실 부분은 유타주에 11개 영안실과 5개 묘지, 캘리포니아주에 1개 묘지, 뉴멕시코주에 1개 묘지와 4개 영안실로 구성되어 있습니다. 이 세그먼트는 또한 플롯, 매장 금고, 영묘 지하실, 마커, 관, 항아리 및 기타 사망 관리 관련 제품을 제공합니다. 장의사의 전문적인 서비스, 묘지 개폐, 예배당 및 열람실 이용, 자동차 및 의복 이용 등의 서비스를 제공합니다.
